title: The time-stamp check reads send_message text too
why: Coordinator 12:43 CST Nov 12: its send_message stamps ran up to 12 minutes ahead of now-central (stamped 12:42-12:53 CST, read 12:42) and no guard refused them; triage caught it by hand.
note: Mistake: a session guesses a clock time in a send_message body ("[coordinator HH:MM CST]") instead of reading now-central. Harm: the receiver files wrong times and orders events wrongly. Fix: the stamp check that refuses a written time more than 1 minute off the clock also reads send_message text, including the "[role HH:MM CST]" form. Red first on a 12:53 stamp sent at 12:41.
